title: fm-gate.sh, the seven gates
acceptance: each of the seven gates has one passing and one blocking case, fourteen in all
gate 5 blocks a pull request whose new test stays green after the implementation is reverted
gate 5 passes a pull request whose new test goes red when the implementation is reverted
gate 4 blocks a diff that reaches outside the task's scope globs in tasks.json
gate 7 ignores an APPROVE string that did not come from the configured reviewer account
the exit code says which gate failed
